acme.title: Reefer temperature excursion response (Acme)
acme.text: When a reefer unit reports a temperature excursion above the setpoint on a cold-chain load, keep the trailer at the cross-dock, download the reefer telemetry log, and notify the Acme cold-chain duty manager before the freight is released. Record the excursion duration and the highest temperature reached in the load record.

globex.title: High-value freight security protocol (Globex)
globex.text: For Globex high-value loads, the trailer stays sealed and under camera watch at every stop, the security desk verifies the seal number at each handover, and any seal mismatch is treated as a security incident: the load does not move until the Globex security desk clears it.
